'''Nog Teleus''' was a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] industrialist who made a fortune on [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] along with [[Cham Teleus]]. Together, the pair decided to relocate to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Out of gratitude for their new home, they chose to organize a number of events to mark the 125th anniversary of the signing of the [[Cularin Compact]]. These included festivals, [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] races, other competitions and an art display of native [[Tarasin]] and other local artwork, including a number from their private collection. A number of items were stolen by [[Gomalo]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] recently released from prison, including a sculpture he had created earlier. It contained the locations of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in which he had stowed the body of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="PAYR" />

The Tynnans sought help from the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]], who assigned [[Ezra Du'Re]] to recover the sculpture. The artwork was eventually recovered by Du'Re, with the aid of some heroes from [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Out of gratitude, the Tynnans gave generous rewards to the heroes.<ref name="PAYR" /> The pair later sponsored the inaugural [[Cularin Classic]] swoop race.<ref name="CV" />
